## Template: `format: typst` {.scrollable}

![](../images/typst-template-partials.svg){fig-alt="A schematic of template.typ as an ordered stack of partial files: numbering.typ (number formats), definitions.typ (helpers), typst-template.typ (defines article()), a dashed header-includes slot, page.typ (#set page()), and typst-show.typ (calls article(doc)).
